title: Microsoft Purview: apply default SharePoint library labels to existing files (Worldwide)
summary: Hold: the licensing paragraph carries client-side entitlements over to service-side auto-labeling, which the current documentation explicitly warns against. The government-cloud roadmap target has also moved from December 2026 to January 2027. The opt-in default, policy limits and operational controls are supported.
